core_cases.prompt: Create a new MySkills Wiki vault at the evaluator-provided absolute temporary path ending in fixture/new-vault. Configure it as the single vault, create only missing safe defaults, run CLI doctor, and do not install QMD, plugins, hooks, Skills, or other programs.

oracle.expected_outcome: The managed launcher setup command receives the resolved absolute temporary path, creates the required safe Wiki structure and single per-user config, preserves the scope boundary, and reports config/vault paths, created artifacts, doctor result, and manual next actions.

assertions.description: The MySkills-managed obsidian-wiki launcher is invoked with setup --vault and the resolved absolute fixture/new-vault path.
The final report states the config path, vault path, created and preserved artifacts, conflicts, and CLI doctor result.
No Skill, CLI, QMD, hook, plugin, or third-party program installation is attempted.

core_cases.prompt: Connect fixture/second-vault as my Wiki. The single existing configuration already points to fixture/first-vault, and I have not authorized replacing that value.

oracle.expected_outcome: The workflow reports the exact configuration conflict, asks whether to replace the existing vault path, and leaves both configuration and vaults unchanged.

assertions.description: The response identifies that the current configured vault differs from the requested vault and requests an explicit replacement decision.
The config value is not replaced and neither vault is modified before the user decides.

core_cases.prompt: Repair missing MySkills Wiki structure in the configured temporary vault. Preserve the existing .obsidian settings and projects/custom.md exactly, create only absent safe defaults, and stop for a decision if any existing value is incompatible.

oracle.expected_outcome: Missing safe defaults are added, existing Obsidian configuration and custom note content are byte-for-byte preserved, incompatible values are reported rather than overwritten, and doctor results are reported.

assertions.description: .obsidian/graph.json and projects/custom.md retain their original content.
Only missing safe defaults and required configuration state are created; incompatible existing values are not replaced without confirmation.

# Custom Project

Do not rewrite this note.

Help me install a third-party Obsidian plugin and enable it in an existing vault.
